titles.display: 1947–1948 civil war in Mandatory Palestine

raw.description: First phase of the 1947–1949 Palestine war
raw.extract: The 1947–1948 civil war in Mandatory Palestine was the first phase of the 1948 Palestine war. It broke out after the General Assembly of the United Nations adopted a resolution on 29 November 1947 recommending the adoption of the Partition Plan for Palestine.
